description: '''Nar Sur''' (Balochi: نڑ سر; also written '''Narh Sur''', '''Nar Sur''' or '''Naṛ Sūr''') is a traditional form of [[flute]] music and [[throat singing]] practised mainly in the [[Koh-e-Sulaiman|Koh-e-Sulaiman region]] of Pakistan. It combines the sound of a long [[Bamboo flute|reed flute]] called the '''nar''' or '''narh''', with a low vocal style called '''sur'''. The flute player and singer perform together following the same rhythm and melody.
